title: oedochloa lanceolata
intro: Oedochloa lanceolata, commonly known as Japanese needle grass, is a species of grass native to East Asia. It is a type of grass that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Oedochloa lanceolata include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, which make it a promising treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Oedochloa lanceolata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
